_comment: Input/output table for Get-SummonDigestLines (deploy/lib/Summon.ps1), the Summon lines at the top of the daily digest (T-human-call-priority-interrupt PR-3, Bohr msg-6965 items 1, 2 and 4). Run by tests/Test-SweepFairness.ps1. controls: project -> raw active_summon value (null = no Summon); a project that is not listed has no control probe row. summon_by_key: the candidate dispositions Get-SummonDisposition produced (kind, owner_project, malformed_project). dispositions: this tick's sweep dispositions. records: key -> summon_threads of its evaluated.json summon_yield record. want: the exact lines, in order; the wording is fixed here.

cases.name: active Summon: held this tick and held earlier both count, the Summon itself and out-of-scope keys do not
want: ヒューマンコール中: S (A)、巻き添えで 3 本停止中、経過 3 時間

cases.name: active Summon under an hour old, nothing held
want: ヒューマンコール中: S (A)、巻き添えで 0 本停止中、経過 1 時間未満

cases.name: owner's active_summon is malformed: the owner's line and the cause on the collateral project
want: ⚠ ヒューマンコール読取不能: M の active_summon の形が壊れている — M の作業は HOLD 中 (fail-safe)
⚠ Q の HOLD の原因: owner プロジェクト M、active_summon の形が壊れている (Q 自身の設定ではない)

cases.name: owner unreachable (no probe row): fail-open, no line
